typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		FileProcessedDtm as string,
		McoName as string,
		MCONumber as string,
		MedicaidID as string,
		MedicaidDSNPPeriod as string,
		FirstName as string,
		LastName as string,
		DateOfBirth as string,
		MBI as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> MCOMEMBERLIST
MCOMEMBERLIST derive({Copy of FirstName} = toString(FirstName),
		{Copy of MedicaidID} = toString(MedicaidID),
		{Copy of MCONumber} = toString(MCONumber),
		{Copy of McoName} = toString(McoName),
		{Copy of MedicaidDSNPPeriod} = toString(MedicaidDSNPPeriod),
		{Copy of LastName} = toString(LastName),
		{Copy of FileProcessedDtm} = toString(FileProcessedDtm),
		{Copy of MBI} = toString(MBI),
		{Copy of DateOfBirth} = toString(DateOfBirth)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion derive(CREATE_DATE = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive(CREATE_DATE = CREATE_DATE) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		DateOfBirth as string,
		CREATE_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MedicaidID as string,
		McoName as string,
		MBI as string,
		FirstName as string,
		FileProcessedDtm as string,
		LastName as string,
		MCONumber as string,
		MedicaidDSNPPeriod as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		DateOfBirth = {Copy of DateOfBirth},
		CREATE_DATE,
		MedicaidID = {Copy of MedicaidID},
		McoName = {Copy of McoName},
		MBI = {Copy of MBI},
		FirstName = {Copy of FirstName},
		FileProcessedDtm = {Copy of FileProcessedDtm},
		LastName = {Copy of LastName},
		MCONumber = {Copy of MCONumber},
		MedicaidDSNPPeriod = {Copy of MedicaidDSNPPeriod})) ~> MCOMEMBERLISTSTG
